action: Update Adobe Connect on Windows to 12.12.a (or the fixed build for your branch: 12.11.i, 12.10.f, 12.9.a, 12.8.a) promptly; Adobe rates the update priority 2.
exec: An internet-facing web-conferencing server with 17 critical flaws, several allowing code execution, should be patched before attackers study the fixes.
plain: Adobe patched 24 flaws in Adobe Connect on Windows, 17 rated critical. Adobe says it knows of no attacks yet.

key_findings: Adobe bulletin APSB26-191 was published on November 10, 2026 with priority 2 and covers Adobe Connect on Windows, versions 12.12 and earlier.
It lists 24 CVEs: 17 Critical, 5 High and 2 Medium, with CVSS 3.1 scores up to 10.0.
Impacts include code execution, privilege escalation, SSRF, path traversal and SQL injection.
Adobe states it is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed.
JPCERT/CC's weekly report of November 18 also lists the bulletin.
recommendations: Update to 12.12.a, 12.11.i, 12.10.f, 12.9.a or 12.8.a according to the branch in use.

summary: Adobe bulletin APSB26-191 of November 10 fixes 24 vulnerabilities in Adobe Connect on Windows, versions 12.12 and earlier: 17 Critical, 5 High and 2 Medium, with CVSS scores up to 10.0 and impacts including code execution. Adobe says it is not aware of exploits in the wild.
title: Adobe Connect update fixes 24 vulnerabilities, 17 critical (APSB26-191)

validation.note: Adobe bulletin read in full; JPCERT/CC weekly report cites the same bulletin.
